contexts.text: Abraham, he stood yet before Jehovah () = the Lord's thought from the Human.
I stand by the fountain of waters () = the state of conjunction of truth Divine in the Human.
He stood by the camels () = presence in general scientifics.
Why standest thou without? () = somewhat therefrom.
To stand in the breach () = to defend and take care lest falsities break in.
Behold he was standing by the river () = from boundary to boundary. Explained.
When he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt () = when his presence was in the Natural... To stand before anyone = presence.
They stood before Joseph () = the presence of the Celestial of the Spiritual there.
All that stood with him () = such things as hinder conjunction. AC 5872.
They who are in truth stand erect...
To stand in the way () = manifestation.
Not to be able to stand before anyone () = not to be able to be present.
For this have I made thee stand () = that as yet communication remained, and they passed through states according to order. Explained.
Ye shall stand no longer () = to be no longer detained.
The people stood by Moses () = obedience then from truth Divine. Explained. AC 8690.
They stood afar off () = removal from internal things.
They stood at the door of the tent () = ... that they were outside what is holy of the worship, etc. AC 10551.
In Heaven no one is allowed to stand at another's back...
Standing before the throne... () = hearing the Lord and doing what He commands. To stand before God = to hear and do what He commands. Illustrated. AR 369. AR 390. AR 493.
They were seen as if lying down while they were deliberating; and as standing when they had come to a conclusion.
To stand upon their feet () = natural life accordant with spiritual life; thus to be vivified by the Lord. AE 666.
To stand before God () = to be presented and gathered together to Judgment.
They stood round the table... and whispered devout praise to the Lord.
They stood, now, near the Angel; now, near the Satans, favouring those they stood near.
Certain appear standing in their places who told me they were walking.
To stand is predicated of truth.
Who is able to stand? () = who will endure and live?
The word stand, like walk, and sit, = to be and to live; and stand has a similar signification to stand firm, and stand still. Illustrated. AE 666.
Standing before the throne... = those in the Lord's Kingdom.
Stood around the throne () = conj unction... AE 489.
To stand upon them () = that they are subject to Him.
The Angel stood near () = the will of the Lord, and command.
To stand near Him () = to be and to come forth from Him.

Which stand before the God of the earth () = which are Divine things proceeding from the Lord, and are His in Heaven and the Church... To stand before Him = to be from Him; thus what is His in Heaven and the Church.

To stand before God, when said in the Word of Angels and the men of the Church, = to be from Him... for all the esse of Heaven and the world proceeds from the Lord... This proceeding Divine is called the Word, which is called the Divine truth... and as this extends itself around the Lord in every direction, it is that which is properly said to stand before Him... for it looks to the Lord as its centre, and so therefore do the Angels who are recipients of it... from which it is that the Angels are said to stand before the Lord; for to stand is properly said of the Divine truth, because it encompasses the Lord as a Sun.
To stand before God = to be in the Divine truth, consequently with the Lord, in the following passages. Illustrated.

(Thus) to stand before the God of the earth = the Divine which proceeds from the Lord, which is His in Heaven and the Church. That this, and those in it, are meant, may be evident from the fact, that to stand before the God of the earth is said of the two olive-trees, and of the two candlesticks, by which are signified good and truth, consequently the proceeding Divine.
(Thus) to stand upon the feet = new life such as belongs to a regenerate man. Illustrated.
To stand () = what belongs to the life of the intention from the will.
To stand before Him = to regard and to understand what He wills.
I stood upon the sand of the sea () = a continuation of the state...
Lo a lamb standing upon mount Zion () = the presence of the Lord in Heaven and the Church... To stand = to be present and conjoined.
Standing near the sea of glass () = because they were in truths from the Word... To stand near it = to be in them.
They stood afar off () = not so much in these things, through fear.
